exemplars: From day one, we wanted Tally to feel different. Not just easier, but better. More fun to use. More flexible. Software you actually enjoy opening, not something you tolerate.

We believe tools should empower you and your work. Not limit you with features locked behind paywalls or constant nudges to upgrade. Good tools should be accessible, generous, and grow with you. That’s why Tally is free for most use cases, and stays affordable when you need more.

We’re a small, independent team based in Europe, bootstrapped and funded by our customers. That gives us the freedom to build the product the way we think it should be built. We care about the long term. About building something opinionated, focused, and something people genuinely love to use.
Say goodbye to boring forms and surveys. Meet Tally — the free, intuitive form builder you’ve been looking for.
